intro: Smart and compact, the Jaxon corner table brings modern elegance and clever storage to tight spaces—where every inch counts and style still shines.

features.title: Clever, concealed storage
features.text: Removable or slidable panels reveal hidden storage inside—perfect for managing clutter or hiding chargers, all within a clean, compact design.

features.title: Smooth suede finish
features.text: Finished in a refined Rimini Walnut suede texture, your corner table brings warm sophistication and tactile comfort to any space.

features.title: Small in size, big in utility
features.text: Its compact footprint makes it an ideal fit for tight corners, beside your sofa, or as a stylish end table in cozy spaces.

features.title: Display with purpose
features.text: An additional open shelf offers space to showcase books, planters, or décor—keeping beauty and utility in perfect balance.

features.title: Lifted and light
features.text: The elevated structure adds a light, airy feel to your room while making floor cleaning effortless and mess-free.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
